title: Ruuvi Air
body:
## Provide Bluetooth coverage

Set up the sensor according to its manufacturer instructions. The documented integration is ruuvitag_ble; the component can use a Bluetooth proxy supplied by Room presence.

## Check the entities

Verify the CO2, particle and other available readings before mapping air inputs. The air page is conditional on those inputs; a temperature-only setup does not automatically gain air-quality measurements.

## Setup references

- [Ruuvi BLE setup — Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ruuvitag_ble/)

These upstream instructions may evolve; the component versions and pinned source above record the DomoSenso scope.
